# M3-4: Headless claude runner

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-4`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-4`
- Depends on: M3-2
- Touches (exclusive while running): llm/
- Plan refs: §5a (classifier site and auth probe), spikes/claude-cli.md §Final command lines, claude-cli-review.md, claude-cli-review-4b.md
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`llm/` runs the pinned `claude` CLI safely for the classifier second opinion and the daily auth probe.

## Scope
- Every call, exactly: absolute path to pinned `claude` 2.1.312, `--model haiku`, prompt on **stdin** (never argv), cwd an empty dedicated directory,
  env limited to `DISABLE_UPDATES=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=…` plus what the binary
  needs (`HOME`, `PATH`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`). Build the env from an allowlist so `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` can't pass through. Not `--bare`.
- Classifier flags, exactly: `-p --model haiku --output-format json --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands
  --no-session-persistence --json-schema <schema>`. No `--max-turns 1`. No MCP.
- Success ⇔ `rc==0 && !.is_error && .structured_output != null`. Anything else, including `is_error:false` with null output, is an error.
- Batches of about 10 (`{results:[{id,category,p}]}`); every id must come back exactly once; an unknown category fails the batch.
- Implement `classify.Model` with this.
- `Probe`: daily health check passes only if `rc==0 && !.is_error && trimmed lowercase .result == "ok"`; on failure it returns `api_error_status`.
- Single-worker queue, timeout plus one retry, ctx cancellation kills the child process.
- Exec behind an interface with a fake. Env-gated `CLAUDE_LIVE=1` test.

## Out of scope
- The Slack free-text call site, `--resume`, `--mcp-config` (M5). Dockerfile (M3-17).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: exact argv for the classifier call, with no prompt text on argv.
- [ ] Test: child env has no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` even when the parent sets it; cwd is the empty directory.
- [ ] Table test: nonzero rc, `is_error:true`, null structured output, duplicate id, missing id and unknown category all return errors.
- [ ] Table test: probe accepts `" OK\n"`, rejects `"not ok"`, rc 1 and `is_error:true` (with 401 surfaced).
- [ ] Test: cancelling ctx ends the child; errors never contain the token or the prompt.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
